text: Long day. I'm a childminder and one of mine, an 11 yr old lad, is staying over tonight as his parents got stuck. His eczema's flared right up, dry itchy patches on the backs of his knees and inside his elbows, and he keeps scratching them. He's wide awake, chatting away, watching telly, perfectly with it. I've got his usual cream but it doesn't seem to be helping much. Anything else I can do tonight to ease the itching so we can both get some sleep?
